input_fields.name: clean_entry_state
input_fields.description: Observed clean design/baseline-copy entry, session identity, and no-dialog state.

input_fields.name: loaded_corrected_script
input_fields.description: Corrected script path/hash already loaded in matching session/document.

input_fields.name: prior_failure_reference
input_fields.description: Earlier failure identity and repair reference for correlation.

result_fields.name: rerun_event
result_fields.description: One rerun ID, launch time, corrected hash, clean-entry identity, and prior-failure link.

result_fields.name: launch_status
result_fields.description: One of launched, rejected, or needs_manual_review; no terminal result.

procedure: Verify clean entry, loaded hash, authorization, no-dialog state, and prior-failure link.
Issue one execution command and record a new rerun identifier.
Return rerun_event with launch_status=launched; hand waiting to EX-10.
If any gate is uncertain, return needs_manual_review and do not issue a second command.
rejection_rules: Reject dirty/unknown entry, hash mismatch, missing failure link, active run, or missing authorization.
Do not treat launch as completion.
